Gideon, from the #inc-vtg-hartford record:

- **First report:** your message at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, "gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant," with both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan.
- **Guard in the meantime:** writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Mateo reported six trucks waiting at the east gate at 10:44, and Door 14 needed the resin delivery before the afternoon shift.
- **Recovery:** Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03, when the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch saw it. Both lanes were working by 11:07.

I got this from a keyword search of the channel history, which is degraded, so it may not be the full picture. I couldn't pull the channel history directly to confirm there was no earlier report.
